review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve cue edits across decks sharing the same track**

When the same track is loaded on both decks, each deck holds a separate snapshot of its local cue bank, but this assignment replaces the shared session bank wholesale. For example, load track 1 on both decks, delete cue 1 on deck 1, then store cue 3 on deck 2: deck 2's stale bank overwrites deck 1's deletion, so reloading the track resurrects cue 1. Synchronize local banks for decks sharing a track, or merge individual slot edits into the latest session bank, so editing another deck does not silently discard retained cues or tombstones.

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Record track end only when entering the end-of-track state**

After a deck reaches EOF, every additional press of `JUMP +` generates another seek whose position is clamped to the duration, so this branch records another `EndOfTrack` even though the deck remains stopped at the same endpoint. Repeated presses inflate the track-end counter and can fill the bounded history with duplicate events, evicting actual load or fault observations. Distinguish a transition to EOF from a seek that leaves the deck at EOF before recording the event.

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Deliver a worker event for pre-Ready media failures**

With `runtime-health` enabled, failures in `MscDevice::new`, `device.lun(0)`, or `probe_capacity` call `shared_on_detached` and immediately continue without sending a `Usb0MscOwnerEvent::Detached`. This invalidation therefore leaves the new producer pending forever: `MediaHealthReporter` can claim it only when processing a matching Detached event, and its existing producer is now superseded. The media worker continues running, but the snapshot remains `Awaiting` indefinitely, with no accepted heartbeat or disconnected/failure observation until another successful attachment. Deliver the matching lifecycle event on these early cleanup paths so the worker can resume publication.
